name: Triage Design System — enforceable rule catalogue
description: Normative rules checked by triage-lint (lint/). Each ID is stable and citable; agents and CI must treat severities as the default contract, overridable per project in .triagerc.json.

rules.name: deprecated-name
rules.summary: Uses a pre-Triage (mail-triage era) class, id or global instead of the renamed vocabulary.
rules.why: The 0.1.0 rename sweep defined the public vocabulary; old names are no longer styled by core.css and silently fall back to browser defaults.

rules.name: raw-colour
rules.summary: A colour literal appears where a token exists (palette match = error) or that is not in the palette (off-system colour = warning).
rules.why: Colour is tokenised in tokens/tokens.json; literals fork the theme and bypass the semantic alias tier.
rules.fix: Use var(--token) (prefer semantic aliases: --surface-*, --text-*, --status-*) or add the colour to tokens.json.

rules.name: non-zero-radius
rules.summary: A non-zero border-radius (CSS property or JS style key).
rules.why: Zero radius is a design-system token (misc.radius = 0px), enforced globally by *{border-radius:0 !important}.
rules.fix: Remove the radius, or fork the system deliberately by changing the token and deleting the global rule.

rules.name: focus-removed
rules.summary: outline:none / outline:0 without a visible focus replacement in the same rule.
rules.why: The global :focus-visible ring is accessibility-critical (WCAG 2.4.7/1.4.11); removing it without replacement fails the system's a11y gate.
rules.fix: Keep the global ring, or provide :focus-visible with a 2px+ ring or a compensating box-shadow/border change.

rules.name: off-scale-spacing
rules.summary: Margin/padding/gap/inset px values outside the normalised spacing scale.
rules.why: Triage ships a 2/4px-grid spacing scale (tokens.json spacing group); ad-hoc values are the measured drift the system exists to stop.
rules.fix: Snap to the nearest scale value or extend the scale in tokens.json deliberately.

rules.name: off-token-motion
rules.summary: Transition/animation duration not in the motion token set.
rules.why: Durations are tokens (motion.duration); ad-hoc values break the motion feel and the Material-3-derived ranges.
rules.fix: Use a motion duration token value (100/120/150/180/200/240/250/280/400ms).

rules.name: off-ladder-zindex
rules.why: The z-index ladder (bulkbar 6 … toasts 300) is a contract; anything full-screen must clear 180 or the mobile tab bar punches through.
rules.fix: Use a ladder value or extend misc.zindex in tokens.json.

rules.name: off-system-font
rules.summary: font-family declaration not using Geist / Geist Mono (or inherit).
rules.why: Typography is part of the system identity and the variable-font loading strategy.
rules.fix: Use the system stacks (or var(--mono)), or change the token in tokens.json for a deliberate rebrand.

rules.name: token-override
rules.summary: A project stylesheet redefines a Triage custom property (--bg, --acc, --surface-* …).
rules.why: Tokens are the source of truth; local overrides fork the theme invisibly and break contrast guarantees.
rules.fix: Edit tokens/tokens.json and regenerate, or use a distinct non-system variable name for local values.

rules.name: unknown-class
rules.summary: A class used in markup that core.css / patterns.css do not define (opt-in, may be a project class).
rules.why: Design elements should come from the system catalogue; unknown classes are how bespoke one-offs creep in.
rules.fix: Use a system class, or allowlist the project class in .triagerc.json.

rules.name: contrast
rules.summary: A defined token pair fails WCAG contrast (4.5:1 text / 3:1 non-text).
rules.why: The token set is the contrast contract; theme overrides can silently break it.
rules.fix: Adjust the token value(s) so the pair meets the threshold, or extend .triagerc.json contrastPairs for intentional exceptions.

rules.name: primitive-use
rules.summary: A product stylesheet consumes a primitive token directly where a semantic alias exists.
rules.why: The alias tier is what makes retheming possible without touching components; primitive use forks the theme.
rules.fix: Use the alias (e.g. var(--surface-card) instead of var(--card)). Definitions inside tokens.css are exempt.

rules.name: physical-direction
rules.summary: Physical direction property (margin-left, left:, text-align:left …) instead of logical properties.
rules.why: The system supports RTL via logical properties; physical properties double the stylesheet and break direction switching.
rules.fix: Use margin-inline-start/end, padding-inline-*, border-inline-*, inset-inline-*, text-align:start/end.

rules.name: image-alt
rules.why: Alt text is the accessibility contract for images; decorative images still need alt="".
rules.fix: Add alt with a description, or alt="" when the image is decorative.

rules.name: accessible-name
rules.summary: Interactive element with no accessible name (empty button/link, no aria-label), or a positive tabindex.
rules.why: Icon-only controls without labels are unusable with assistive tech; positive tabindex breaks natural order (WCAG 2.4.3).
rules.fix: Add text or aria-label; never use tabindex > 0.

rules.name: label-tier
rules.summary: Label-role class (.badge, .nav-label, .cmd-group) set below the comfortable label target (13px at the 16px root).
rules.why: Supporting labels target 13-14px at comfortable density and 12px is reserved for tertiary metadata (timestamps in dense tables, keyboard hints, provenance footnotes). The floor stays an error; this tier check is adoption guidance, not a failure.
rules.fix: Use the system token (--fs-badge / --fs-nav-label) or set the label role to 13px+ (0.8125rem+).

score.gate: CI fails on any error; --max-warnings can tighten warnings.
